verse.verse_1: Have you received the news of the Enveloper?
verse.verse_2: On that Day faces shall be humbled,
verse.verse_5: that is fueled from a tremendously hot fountain,
verse.verse_6: no food for them except thorny plants
verse.verse_7: which neither sustains, nor satisfy hunger.
verse.verse_8: (Whereas other) faces on that Day will be joyful,
verse.verse_11: where they will hear no idle talk.
verse.verse_12: A gushing fountain shall be there
verse.verse_17: What, do they not reflect upon how the camel was created?
verse.verse_18: And how the heaven was raised up,
verse.verse_19: and how the mountains were firmly fixed?
verse.verse_20: And how the earth was outstretched?
verse.verse_21: Therefore remind, you are only a Reminder.
verse.verse_22: You are not charged to oversee them.
verse.verse_23: As for those who turn their back and disbelieve,
verse.verse_24: Allah will punish them with the greatest punishment.
verse.verse_25: Indeed, to Us they shall return,
verse.verse_26: then upon Us shall rest their reckoning.
